definition: staying steady in your mind under stress
description: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.
